bar_chart.name: 가로 막대 차트
bar_chart.use_when: Ranking or comparing 3-7 numbers (e.g. amounts by city). highlight = index of the item to emphasise.

data.title: 直轄市甲級獎勵金比較

board.name: 카드 보드 (무대)
board.use_when: A set of 3-6 things (documents, tasks, conditions, options) that the narration first introduces, then lines up (optionally with a value each), sorts into 2-4 groups, and/or highlights. The same cards stay on screen and rearrange across beats.

beats.note: 影本要看得到生效日期

brand_intro.name: 채널 인트로
brand_intro.use_when: Inserted automatically right after the opening hook in long-form videos (style pacing.brand_intro). Not chosen by the LLM.

callout.name: 주의/팁 박스
callout.use_when: An important warning, tip or note in a box, optionally with one big figure (big, e.g. NT$60,000). tone: warning|tip|info.

data.title: 原住民專屬高額獎勵
data.body: 請暫緩申請縣市獎勵金，優先選擇中央原民會專案！

card_set.name: 조건 카드 세트
card_set.use_when: 2-5 conditions or key points as cards. check=true ticks them one by one ("all must be met"). Good for a final recap.

chapter_card.name: 챕터 구분 카드
chapter_card.use_when: Inserted automatically at the start of every chapter after the first. Not chosen by the LLM.

compare.name: A vs B 비교
compare.use_when: Comparing two things side by side; value can hold an amount or key figure; verdict sums it up.

data.title: 0 元考照疊加方案
data.verdict: 達成真正的 0 成本升級！

contrast.name: 전환점 한 글자
contrast.use_when: A turning point: one huge character (e.g. 但, 其實) plus a short sentence.

counter.name: 숫자 카운트업
counter.use_when: One key number counting up from 0 (money, people, days). Strong as the opening hook.

document_form.name: 서류 목업
document_form.use_when: What to fill in on an application form, or which fields to check on a certificate/document (dates, amounts, names). 2-5 label/value rows written one by one; highlight marks the key field; optional stamp (e.g. approved) and a side note.

doodle_scene.name: 낙서 장면 (무대)
doodle_scene.use_when: A small everyday story or situation told in 2-5 beats: a person (with poses like cheer, think, sad, point, phone, walk) and objects appear one by one on a ground line; poses change; red circle / cross / check / arrow marks point at what matters. Great for 'what happens if…' examples and common mistakes.

beats.note: 生效日起九十天內申請

flow.name: 흐름도 (무대)
flow.use_when: A path that BRANCHES and merges: a starting point, then a column with 2-4 options or routes, then a common result. Columns are drawn one by one across beats while the camera follows.

globe.name: 지구본
globe.use_when: Connections from one place to other countries or cities (overseas work, international recognition, trade). Statement on the left, arcs drawn one by one.

growth_line.name: 성장 곡선
growth_line.use_when: A value changing over time or stages (3-7 points): the line grows point by point while a big number follows its tip. Best for growth or progress.

headline.name: 큰 글자 한 줄
headline.use_when: One key message in huge type, line by line. Use strike to cross out a misconception.

data.kicker: 別以為單一級只能領丙級金額

headline_object.name: 큰 글자 + 사물 그림
headline_object.use_when: A key message paired with a concrete object (certificate, cash, document, calendar with a number, ID card, bankbook).

icon_series.name: 아이콘 시리즈
icon_series.use_when: Introducing 2-5 categories or kinds one at a time, each with a big keyword, a short subtitle and an icon.

items.title: 證照獎勵金
items.sub: 各縣市發放・最高兩萬元

items.title: 原民會專案
items.sub: 原住民身分・最高六萬元

list.name: 목록
list.use_when: A list of 2-5 items with optional one-line notes (requirements, documents, cautions). style: check|number|doc|bullet.

outro.name: 끝 화면 + 도장
outro.use_when: The last shot: big title with a stamp as the call to action.

data.title: LONGEPASS 容易通
data.sub: 隨時隨地練習考題，一次過關領獎金

people_ratio.name: 그림 비율
people_ratio.use_when: A ratio or 'K out of N' fact (N up to 24): N people (or objects) appear in rows and K of them change color, with the ratio in big type.

data.label: 沒有一般勞工獎勵金的縣市
data.sub: 申請前先確認自己的縣市

phone_screen.name: 휴대폰 화면
phone_screen.use_when: Something done on a phone: an online application or registration flow, or using the app (practice questions, wrong-answer notes, mock exams). A title + caption beside a phone whose screen lists 2-5 menu rows; one row can be tapped.

data.title: 線上就能報名
data.caption: 不用跑櫃台，手機就能完成

photo_collage.name: 사진 모음
photo_collage.use_when: 2-4 real examples shown side by side: jobs, places, products, cases, people. Each photo gets a short caption.

photo_full.name: 전면 사진 + 큰 글자
photo_full.use_when: A real-world photo or short video clip carries the moment (a place, people, an object, news scene) and one strong line sits on top. Good as a hook, a scene change or a breather between card-style shots.

photo_split.name: 반 사진 + 요점
photo_split.use_when: Explaining something concrete that has a real image (a place, a workplace, an exam room, a product, a person's situation) with a short title and up to 4 short points.

quiz.name: 맞혀 보기 퀴즈
quiz.use_when: Let viewers guess a key fact from the article before revealing it (a deadline, an amount, a rule people often get wrong). Question + 2-4 options, the answer is revealed when the narration says it. Great as a short-form hook or a mid-video attention reset.

data.question: 取得證照後，最晚幾天內要申請？

quote_card.name: 인용·출처
quote_card.use_when: Quoting a source to back a claim: an official notice, a law article, a news sentence, an expert or a real person's words. Always name the source.

data.label: 官方規定
data.quote: 技術士證生效日起九十日內應提出申請，逾期不予受理。

data.label: 學員心得
data.quote: 最後悔的就是拖了四個月才去申請。

radar.name: 레이더 차트
radar.use_when: Profile across 3-6 dimensions scored 0-100 (strengths and weaknesses), optionally against a baseline (base). Big statement on the left.

screen_focus.name: 화면 캡처 확대
screen_focus.use_when: Showing evidence from a real source: an official notice, a government web page, a news article or an app screen, then zooming into the exact line that matters (deadline, amount, rule). The source is shown beside the screenshot.

data.title: 官方公告怎麼寫
data.source: 勞動部 技能檢定公告（範例）

taiwan_map.name: 대만 지도
taiwan_map.use_when: Comparing regions of Taiwan: colour 1-4 groups of counties and label them. Use county names like 台北市.

data.title: 無一般勞工獎勵金縣市

tiles.name: 이름표 타일
tiles.use_when: Many short labels (e.g. 20 county names) filling in one by one, then one big word in the middle.

timeline.name: 시간 흐름·기한
timeline.use_when: Things that happen at points in time: deadlines, exam schedule, 'within 90 days of X', training period then subsidy payment. 2-5 points with a time label (when) and what happens; deadline marks the point that must not be missed.

title_card.name: 영상 제목 카드
title_card.use_when: Right after the opening hook: names the video topic and what the viewer will learn.

data.title: 證照獎勵金懶人包
data.sub: 完整盤點補助標準，教你領回萬元現金

word_slam.name: 단어 쾅쾅
word_slam.use_when: A punchy rhythm of 2-5 very short words or phrases said one after another (a slogan, a three-beat summary, a turning point). Changes the pace between information shots.
